name: Save files to SharePoint
description: Stores the files a converter node lists into the SharePoint team library, under sharepoint_folder (argument) and, when the input names one, a new subfolder folder_name. A file carries its content as base64 or as a tool call (server, tool, args) that returns it; that call is made just before the upload, so tick its server too (e.g. Outlook). Output: {status: stored, folder, files, web_urls, skipped, source}. Any failure → error, with the reason.
